title: Rosalind schema-5 receipt envelope
description: The canonical on-disk run or reproduction receipt. All scalar values are strings. Canonical key ordering and self-hash semantics are defined by docs/receipt-schema.md.

measurements.description: Machine- and run-local telemetry excluded from the portable claim and protected by measurement_blake3.

params.description: Deterministic claim fields. Unprefixed keys and non-x namespaces are reserved to Rosalind. producer.* and analyzer.* are standardized identities. Extensions must use x.<reverse-dns>.*.

command_argv.description: Canonical JSON string containing an argv string array. Present when replay_schema is 2 or 3. Replay schema 3 additionally binds a validated producer kind and strict operand markers.

path.description: Portable lookup metadata. For schema 3 and newer it is excluded from the deterministic claim hash.
